children: Verma, who previously served as Executive Director, will lead the company’s core businesses and evaluate expansion opportunities in India and overseas
GP Petroleums Limited (GPPL) has appointed Arjun Verma as its Managing Director, effective 27 October 2026. Verma was previously serving as the company’s Executive Director.

In his new role, Verma will lead the company’s business verticals, with a focus on strengthening its existing operations and evaluating expansion opportunities in domestic and overseas markets. The company said its plans could include strategic investments and acquisitions, with an emphasis on capital allocation, profitable growth and improving cash flows.
A Chartered Accountant with more than 35 years of experience, Verma has been involved in shaping GPPL’s financial strategy and supporting its governance and business initiatives.

Ayush Goel, Executive Chairman and Whole-Time Director of GP Petroleums, said Verma’s understanding of the company and financial expertise would support its focus on strengthening core businesses and improving shareholder returns.
The leadership change comes after GPPL reported a rise in its financial performance for the second quarter of FY27.
The company’s profit after tax (PAT) increased 179 per cent year-on-year to Rs 15.3 crore in Q2 FY27, compared with Rs 5.5 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous financial year.
Revenue rose 124 per cent to Rs 340.8 crore from Rs 152.4 crore in Q2 FY26.
